9.source_en: "/h or /help: Shows this Command Help List",

17.source_en: "/bv (0~127): Controls the volume of the BGM",

31.source_en: "F12 Brings up a Hotkey Window which allows you to drag and drop Recovery Items, Equipment and Skills into it for faster access.",
31.translation_tr: "F12 hizli erisim penceresini acar; iyilestirme esyalari, ekipmanlar ve skiller buraya suruklenebilir.",

32.source_en: "If Party Leader right click on a character a menu appears to request a player to join the party.",
32.translation_tr: "Parti lideri bir karaktere sag tiklarsa oyuncuyu partiye davet etme menusu acilir.",

37.source_en: "[F10]: To toggle Chat Window size; [Alt] + [F10]: Toggle Chat Window On/Off",
37.translation_tr: "[F10]: Sohbet penceresi boyutunu degistirir; [Alt] + [F10]: Sohbet penceresini Acar/Kapatir",

38.source_en: "How to Whisper: Enter a Character's Name on the left side of chat window and type your message on the right side. The Tab key helps you move between these boxes.",
38.translation_tr: "Fisilti: Sohbet penceresinin soluna karakter adini, sagina mesaji yaz. Tab tusu alanlar arasinda gecis yapar.",

41.translation_tr: "Ekran goruntusu almak icin [Print Screen] veya [Scroll Lock] tusuna bas.",

42.source_en: "/memo: To memorize a place as Warp Point (If you have Warp Portal skill)",
42.translation_tr: "/memo: Konumu Warp Point olarak kaydeder (Warp Portal skillin varsa)",

43.source_en: "/snap: Turns snap On/Off for fights, /skillsnap: Turns snap On/Off for skills. /itemsnap: Turns snap On/Off for items on the grounds.#",
43.translation_tr: "/snap: Savasta hedef yakalamayi Acar/Kapatir, /skillsnap: skill hedeflemeyi Acar/Kapatir. /itemsnap: yerdeki esya hedeflemeyi Acar/Kapatir.#",

57.source_en: "/quickspell: Right-click menu enables you to use skills assigned to the F9 hotkey. On/Off",
57.translation_tr: "/quickspell: Sag tik ile F9 kisayoluna atanmis skilleri kullanmani saglar. Ac/Kapat",

58.translation_tr: "/quickspell2: Fare tekerlegiyle F7 ve F8'e atanmis skilleri kullanmani saglar. Ac/Kapat",

68.source_en: "/noshift: You may use your \"force heal\" ability without the Shift key. On/Off",
68.translation_tr: "/noshift: Shift tusu olmadan \"force heal\" kullanmani saglar. Ac/Kapat",

69.translation_tr: "/noctrl | /nc: Ctrl tusuna basmadan otomatik saldiriyi Acar/Kapatir",
